nodes.t: Your wife is in Box 4 in your jersey. Number 18. The jersey has your name on it. The internet has lost its mind.

nodes.n: Mumbai, under lights. You're batting. Last over. Eleven to win. Somewhere in Box 4, a woman who thinks a googly is an egg is standing on her chair.

moment.title: 11 off 6
moment.desc: Captain's knock. Sixty thousand people. Your fake wife screaming in Box 4.

nodes.n: Six over long-on. You point your bat at Box 4 without thinking. She's jumping. Actually jumping.
Three short. You walk off. In Box 4, Tara is the only person still standing, clapping.
Post-match ceremony. The big screen cuts to Box 4. Then to you. A heart frame appears around both faces. KISS CAM. Sixty thousand people chanting.

choice.t: Blow her a kiss from the field.

nodes.n: You climb three rows of seats in your pads. She meets you halfway. The stadium shakes. Nikhil, somewhere, starts crying with joy.
Midnight. A video drops on Vivaan Rai's channel. Twelve seconds long. Just his face, smiling.

nodes.t: Their marriage is fake. I have the proof. Part one, tomorrow at 9 PM.

nodes.cliff: Vivaan Rai has proof. And he's releasing it in parts, like a film.
